changeSet.sql:
DELETE FROM floor_order_payments keep USING floor_order_payments newer WHERE keep.order_id = newer.order_id AND keep.paid_at < newer.paid_at;
DELETE FROM floor_order_payments keep USING floor_order_payments twin WHERE keep.order_id = twin.order_id AND keep.paid_at = twin.paid_at AND keep.id::text > twin.id::text;
